decisions.reason: The resin injection unit fits the firm's injection and plural-component core, and no reported shortfall against aspiration would trigger search, though the post-2020 squeeze on slack raises the risk somewhat.
Its overlap with Product A makes it the more likely candidate for pruning, as the firm already showed with Product C, but without evidence of a clear performance gap it is kept for now.
The manual airless gun is a staple item with steady demand and spare-part pull, so it likely meets aspirations.
The multi-model air-assisted line serves established finishing customers, and its breadth makes withdrawal of the whole line unlikely.
The data logger's results remain the most uncertain and slack is tighter after the downturn, but it matches the firm's digital and innovation direction, so management gives it more time.
